title: Fundamental groups commute with algebraic constant-field limits
statement:
Let $K$ be a field and $L/K$ a separable algebraic extension [def-pc-field-extension, def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. Let $X_0$ be a separated finite-type $K$-scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. For each intermediate field $K\subseteq E\subseteq L$ with $[E:K]<\infty$, put $X_E=X_0\times_K E$, and put $X_L=X_0\times_K L$ [def-pc-base-change]. Assume that $X_L$ and every $X_E$ are connected [def-weil-connected-scheme], and choose a geometric point $\bar x\to X_L$ [def-weil-geometric-point]. Give each $X_E$ the composite point $\bar x_E$. Use the profinite fundamental groups of [def-galois-fibre-functor]. The homomorphisms induced by the projections [lem-galois-pi1-functoriality] give an isomorphism of topological groups
$$\pi_1(X_L,\bar x)\xrightarrow{\sim}\varprojlim_{[E:K]<\infty}\pi_1(X_E,\bar x_E).$$
The transition homomorphism for $E\subseteq E'$ is induced by $X_{E'}\to X_E$. The inverse limit means the subgroup of compatible families in the product, with its subspace topology, and the displayed map has components induced by $X_L\to X_E$.
